_doc: Large batch L01 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to builder defaults.

alpha-dingo/f:x0.note: pounce = a leap that lands point-first; keeps slash for the two rakes only

alpha-dingo/f:u0.note: art says Bite (alpha jaws); bash tag stays mechanical, Howl keeps the only bash

alpha-dingo/f:u1.note: a pack howl signal = sound rings, not a snare

alpha-dingo/f:u3.note: flank run kicks up desert dust; shock (electric) does not fit a dingo

red-fox/f:b1.note: lunge = point-first leap, avoids three slashes

red-fox/f:u0.note: sly feint = a quick wink/glint; no tag and no keyword

red-fox/f:u3.note: brush = undergrowth cover; differs from Den Dash puff

silver-fox/f:u0.note: silver-tipped fur glints on the pounce

silver-fox/f:u1.note: drift dive into a snow drift: snow puff instead of a 4th slash

arctic-fox/f:u0.note: snow dive lands head-first like a lance

arctic-fox/f:u3.note: snow veil = frost glitter; White Out keeps puff

tundra-fox/f:b1.note: pounce = leap point-first; avoids three slashes

tundra-fox/f:u1.note: den shove throws up burrow dust; Mouse Pounce keeps bash

bramble-wolf/f:b1.note: thorn-wrapped maul: spikes instead of a plain slash

bramble-wolf/f:u1.note: art says Bite; bash tag stays on Scent-Trail Dodge only

elder-bramble-wolf/f:u0.note: thorn lunge = point-first; slash kept for Maul and Pounce

badger/f:b1.note: snout ram = head-first jab; differs from the claw slashes

badger/f:u1.note: maul = jaws; Spade-Claw Dig and Warren Bulldoze keep slash

old-brock/f:x0.note: grizzled slam = heavy body slam; Rake and Maul keep slash
